description: Save something to remember in later chats. kind=rule for a standing instruction ("when X happens, do Y", "always answer Z"); kind=note for a preference or fact. shared=true makes it apply to everyone in this account, not only this person. Never store passwords, invoices as truth, DNS, or live account state.

content.description: One or two sentences. Never secrets or live account state.

kind.description: rule = standing instruction Moira always follows; note = preference or fact (default).

shared.description: true = applies to everyone in this account, not only you.

name: oma_remember_note
title: Remember a rule or note
